Welcome to the editor! Feel free to remix this project however you like!

The ideas behind making this project were:

- Use vector sprites only. No bitmap sprites unless necessary.
- Keep it as simple as possible.
- Have over-the-top graphics.
- Make innovative use of Scratch.
- Don't make it too short or too long.

Why is this project so WOW!?

- Learned from playing SNES games (Super Nintendo Entertainment System).
- Read the Scratch forum: Show and Tell > Propose Projects to be Featured.
- Learned more about game mechanics and environments.
- Put all my effort into this project.
- ...And finally, don't give up! :)
